data.description:
## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- dd-3: After attestation, the applier mutates Jira and/or the local tracker per the manifest, and the post-pass orphan count drops to zero or to a reviewer-acknowledged residual

## Given / When / Then
Given a signed human-committed attestation with acknowledged_residual: 0 and a manifest with 5 orphan anomalies (within 10-mutation cap), and first-pass-date.txt showing 3 days ago; When apply --pass P is invoked with mocked Jira and local-tracker mutators; Then exit code is 0, 5 mutator invocations occurred, bridge_state/bootstrap/orphans-P.outcome.json records 5 outcomes, post-pass enumerate returns 0 — AND in three negative scenarios (gate-failing attestation, manifest >10 anomalies in 7-day window, post-pass count > acknowledged_residual) apply exits non-zero with zero mutations after violation detected.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff format --check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] apply refuses to run and performs zero mutations when gate logic fails (gate function invoked internally)
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_orphan_band_apply.py::test_apply_refuses_when_gate_fails
- [ ] apply rejects manifests with >10 anomalies during the first-week window
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_orphan_band_apply.py::test_apply_enforces_first_week_mutation_cap
- [ ] apply executes one mutator invocation per manifest anomaly and records each outcome
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_orphan_band_apply.py::test_apply_executes_per_anomaly_mutations
- [ ] apply exits non-zero when post-pass orphan count exceeds acknowledged_residual
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_orphan_band_apply.py::test_apply_blocks_when_post_pass_count_exceeds_residual
- [ ] apply exits 0 when post-pass count equals acknowledged_residual (including default 0)
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_orphan_band_apply.py::test_apply_succeeds_when_post_pass_within_residual

## File Impact
- plugins/dso/scripts/dso_reconciler/orphan_band.py (Edit)
- tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_orphan_band_apply.py (Create)

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
data.title: RED: Implement orphan-band apply subcommand with 10-mutation cap and post-pass orphan-count check
